Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At the end of class, the teacher asked a Black student and a Latino student to stay after so that she could talk to each of them individually. She told the Black student that she was proud of the recent work they had turned in and suggested they consider entering a science fair. When she talked to the Latino student, she said how disappointed she was that they weren't keeping up with the other students and suggested some tutors. Who is exceeding expectations in the class?
A. Not enough info
B. The Latino student
C. The Black student
